Dish: Pumpkin Crumb Muffins
Instructions: Enjoy at room temperature. To warm, preheat oven to 300°F, place on a sheet tray, cover loosely with foil, and warm for 5–6 minutes. Best within 4–5 days. Can be frozen up to 1 month.

Dish: Fall Chewy Spice Cookies with Molasses, Sugar & Spices
Instructions: Enjoy at room temperature straight from the container. To warm, preheat oven to 300°F, place on a sheet tray, cover loosely with foil, and warm for 4–5 minutes. Best within 5–6 days. Can be frozen up to 1 month.

Dish: Egg Muffin Cups with Onions, Peppers, Broccoli, Mushrooms & Cheddar Cheese
Instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F. Place on a sheet tray, cover loosely with foil, and warm for 8–10 minutes until heated through. Best within 4–5 days. Can be frozen up to 1 month.

Dish: GF, DF Apple Cinnamon Bread with Cinnamon Swirl & Crumble Topping
Instructions: Enjoy at room temperature. To warm, preheat oven to 300°F, wrap loosely in foil, and warm for 8–10 minutes. Best within 4–5 days. Can be frozen up to 1 month.

Dish: Overnight Oats with Greek Yogurt, Stewed Cherries & Chia Seeds
Instructions: Serve cold straight from the refrigerator — no heating needed. Stir well before eating. If you prefer warm oats, preheat oven to 325°F, transfer to an oven-safe dish, cover tightly with foil, and warm for 8–10 minutes. Best within 4–5 days.

Dish: Roasted Corn Salsa with Cilantro, Peppers, Jalapeño, Red Onion, Tomato & Lime Juice
Instructions: Serve cold — no heating needed. Stir gently before serving. Best within 3–4 days.

Dish: Butternut Squash Hummus
Instructions: Serve cold or at room temperature — no heating needed. Stir well before serving. Best within 5–6 days.

Dish: Healing Ginger Coconut Chicken Brown Rice Soup
Instructions: Pour into a saucepan over medium heat. Warm for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until hot throughout. Reduce to low and simmer gently if not serving immediately. Add a splash of broth or water if the soup has thickened. Best within 4–5 days.

Dish: Beef & Barley Soup
Instructions: Pour into a saucepan over medium heat. Warm for 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until hot throughout. Reduce to low and simmer gently if not serving immediately. Add a splash of broth or water if the soup has thickened. Best within 4–5 days.

Category: Kids / Comfort Foods — Served with Steamed Green Beans
Dish: Ham & Cheese Hot Pockets
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place on a sheet tray uncovered and warm for 10–12 minutes, flipping once halfway, until heated through and the pastry is golden and crispy. Place green beans on a separate sheet tray, cover loosely with foil, and warm alongside for the last 6–8 minutes. Best within 3–4 days. Can be frozen up to 1 month — add 3–5 minutes if warming from frozen.

Category: Kids / Comfort Foods — Served with Steamed Green Beans
Dish: Beef Tips & Gravy over Egg Noodles
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Transfer to an oven-safe dish, cover tightly with foil, and warm for 20–25 minutes until heated through and gravy is bubbling, stirring once halfway. Place green beans on a separate sheet tray, cover loosely with foil, and warm alongside for the last 6–8 minutes. Best within 4–5 days.

Category: Kids / Comfort Foods — Served with Steamed Green Beans
Dish: Popcorn Chicken & Smashed Potatoes
Instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread chicken in a single layer on a sheet tray uncovered and warm for 8–10 minutes until hot and crispy — do not cover or the coating will soften. At the same time, place potatoes in a separate oven-safe dish, cover loosely with foil, and warm for 10–12 minutes. Place green beans on a sheet tray, cover loosely with foil, and warm alongside for the last 6–8 minutes. Best within 3–4 days.

Category: Kids / Comfort Foods — Served with Steamed Green Beans
Dish: Black Bean & Corn Quesadillas
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place quesadillas on a sheet tray uncovered and warm for 8–10 minutes, flipping once halfway, until heated through and the tortilla is lightly crispy. Place green beans on a separate sheet tray, cover loosely with foil, and warm alongside for the last 6–8 minutes. Best within 3–4 days.

Dish: Fall Farro Grain Bowl with Roasted Butternut Squash, Roasted Chickpeas, Kale, Halloumi & Lemon Vinaigrette
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Transfer farro, squash, and chickpeas to an oven-safe dish, cover tightly with foil, and warm for 12–15 minutes until heated through. Serve halloumi and kale at room temperature and dress just before eating. Best within 4–5 days.

Dish: Apple, Cranberry & Bacon Kale Salad with Goat Cheese & Apple Cider Vinaigrette
Instructions: Serve cold — no heating needed. Toss gently before serving and dress just before eating to keep the kale fresh. Best within 3–4 days.

Dish: Quinoa & Veggie Power Bowl with Baby Arugula, Maple Chipotle Brussels Sprouts, Smokey Butternut Squash & Apple Cider Vinaigrette
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Transfer quinoa, brussels sprouts, and butternut squash to an oven-safe dish, cover tightly with foil, and warm for 12–15 minutes until heated through. Serve arugula cold on top and dress just before eating. Best within 3–4 days.

Dish: Curry Beef Spice Bowl with Basmati Rice, Ground Beef, Potatoes, Cilantro & Spices
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Transfer to an oven-safe dish, cover tightly with foil, and warm for 18–22 minutes until heated through, stirring once halfway. Best within 4–5 days.

Dish: Zucchini Pesto Pasta with Mushrooms, Zucchini, Toasted Brown Butter Walnuts & Burrata
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Transfer to an oven-safe dish, cover tightly with foil, and warm for 15–18 minutes until heated through, stirring once halfway. Add a small splash of water or olive oil before covering if needed to loosen. Serve burrata at room temperature on top just before eating — do not heat. Best within 3–4 days.

Dish: Beef Barbacoa over Yellow Rice, Grilled Asparagus & Pico de Gallo
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Transfer barbacoa and rice to an oven-safe dish, cover tightly with foil, and warm for 20–25 minutes until heated through. Place asparagus in a separate oven-safe dish, cover loosely with foil, and warm alongside for the last 8–10 minutes. Serve pico de gallo cold on the side. Best within 4–5 days.

Dish: Sweet & Spicy Sambal Chicken Skewers over Black Rice & Broccolini
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Transfer chicken skewers and rice to an oven-safe dish, cover tightly with foil, and warm for 15–18 minutes until heated through. Place broccolini on a separate sheet tray, cover loosely with foil, and warm alongside for the last 8–10 minutes. Best within 4–5 days.

Dish: Dijon, Lemon & Thyme Roasted Salmon over Braised French Lentils & Green Beans
Instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F. Transfer to an oven-safe dish, cover tightly with foil, and warm for 12–15 minutes until just heated through — low and slow keeps the salmon moist and the lentils creamy. Best within 2–3 days.
